question: What should I do at this rest site? Heal, smith a named card (one option per card that can be upgraded, with what the upgrade changes), or another rest action; code plays the action and the card pick. You decide this yourself; no other model is asked first. Code does not score or rank the options: each lists its own facts (the game's text, cost, price, the HP it leaves, what an upgrade changes) and, for a card, relic, event option or rest action, outcome_stats: how our logged runs did after that choice, with n (basis and baseline in facts.outcome_stats_basis; observational, not a verdict). facts are exact: the deck, relics, potions, HP, gold, the act boss clock (damage a turn needed vs this deck's estimate) and your own run plan. Every option is listed, skipping or leaving included. Weigh them for the whole run. Each smith option names its card: code upgrades that card on the next screen without asking again.

facts.outcome_stats_basis: outcome_stats / card_outcome_stats / option_outcome_stats = A10 数据：src/knowledge/outcome-stats.json（日志自动统计，tools/build-outcome-stats.py，生成于 2026-10-12T19:28:47，A10 共 206 局；每个进阶分开统计）；没有记录的写「无数据」。口径：n = 局数（n<5 标「少」）；过本幕boss = 这些局里打过「做这个选择时所在那一幕」boss 的比例；均终层 = 这些局的平均最终层数。卡牌「拿了」= 这一幕里牌组多了这张牌（奖励、商店、事件都算），「给了没拿」= 这一幕的卡牌奖励里给过、这一幕没拿；遗物 = 这一幕获得；事件选项 = 选了这个选项（到下一层第一次决策时的平均 HP/上限/金币变化）；休息点 = 按到达时的 HP 档。观察数据：混有「在什么局面下做这个选择」的因素，不是因果。基线（A10 全部 206 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 75% (n=206)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 49% (n=155)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 3% (n=76)。A10 的一行不足5局、而 A9/A8 的同一行够5局时，后面括号里另附那一行，标明进阶（取最近的一个进阶；另算，不与 A10 的合并）；A9 基线（全部 3 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=3)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 67% (n=3)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 50% (n=2)；A8 基线（全部 1 局）：到达第1幕的局过第1幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第2幕的局过第2幕boss 100% (n=1)，到达第3幕的局过第3幕boss 100% (n=1)。
